content: A compatible current baseline is Node 22.12+, Next 15.5.x with React 19, Tailwind 4 and shadcn generated components, RHF 7/Zod 4, Zustand 5, Decimal.js 10, Prisma 7 with pg adapter, Auth.js stable NextAuth v4 for documented App Router support, Vitest 5 and Playwright Test 1. Pin exact package versions and lockfile; avoid latest Next major because project requires Next 15.
